id: title:bernatixer:give backfill evaluation runs a longer retry budget

review.posthog_relevance: Adds bounded, backfill-specific retry and timeout configuration while preserving live-run behavior, potentially reducing transient failures and improving recovery for backfill evaluation workflows.
review.reason: The implementation hunks P1.F2.H2 and P1.F2.H4 demonstrate a substantive, bounded capability improvement by adding backfill-specific retry and timeout parameters. This could reduce transient failures and improve recovery for backfill evaluation runs. Documentation and test-only hunks do not establish tier.
review.uncertainty: The tier is established by implementation changes, but the actual reduction in transient failures and recovery improvement is not independently verified; this is a potential benefit rather than an observed outcome.
